inherited: This glossary belongs to a team, so it is read-only here. Manage it in the team.

sheet.title: Import a spreadsheet
sheet.description: Applies straight away. Rows you leave out stay as they are, blank cells keep their value and nothing is removed.
sheet.formats: CSV or XLSX, up to 10 MB. TBX works too.
sheet.summaryDescription: Rows with errors stayed as they were.
sheet.nothingChanged: Nothing changed. The file matches the glossary.
sheet.allFailed: No row applied. Fix the rows below and upload the file again.
sheet.unusedLocales: Stored, not used by this space: {locales}.
sheet.moreErrors: {count} more rows are in the copy and the download.

editor.title: Terms
editor.noPermission: Your role can read this glossary but not change it.
editor.selectPage: Select every term on this page

coverage.label: Coverage per language. Press a language to list what it is missing.

empty.title: This glossary has no terms yet
empty.body: Add the first term by hand or bring your terms in from a spreadsheet. Each row is one meaning across your languages.
empty.readOnly: There is nothing to show yet.

bulk.confirmDelete: Delete {count} term with all its languages? This can't be undone. | Delete {count} terms with all their languages? This can't be undone.

languages.label: Languages
languages.addHint: A language code, such as de, fr or de-AT.
languages.invalid: That is not a language code. Try de, fr or de-AT.

fields.avoidHint: Wording the AI must never write. End with * to catch longer forms, like klimaneutral*.
fields.alsoHint: Other ways a text may spell this term, such as inflected forms.
fields.noteHint: The AI reads this when the term comes up. Nothing checks that it followed it, so keep it short.
fields.noteTooLong: Shorten this note to {max} characters to save it.
fields.keepExactHint: For names like Acme: the wording stays as written, in the same upper and lower case. When translating, a language with its own Use gets that wording instead.
fields.ban: Ban: the AI must never write this.
fields.useAvoided: The Avoid entry "{avoid}" also covers "{wording}", so the AI would be flagged for using it. Change one of them.
fields.wordingRequired: Add a Use or Avoid wording here, or remove this language.
fields.noLanguage: Add a wording in at least one language first.
fields.duplicate: Another term already holds this wording in {language}:
fields.refused: Not saved. See the message by the field.
fields.rowChanged: Not saved. Someone else saved this term while you were editing, and their version differs in: {fields}. The form now shows their version with your text kept. Save again to replace those fields.
fields.rowChangedApart: Not saved. Someone else saved this term while you were editing. The form now shows their version with your text kept. Save again to add your text.
fields.rowChangedUnread: Not saved. Someone else saved this term while you were editing, and their version could not be loaded. Your text is still here. Try saving again.
fields.fallback: Uses the {language} wording "{wording}" until this language has its own.

ai.filled: Use suggested by AI, not saved yet
ai.findingsTitle: This suggestion breaks the glossary. Change it before saving:

editor.confirmDelete: Delete "{term}" with all its languages? This can't be undone.
editor.endOfList: That was the last term in this view.
editor.notFound: This term is gone. It may have been deleted.
editor.sheetDescription: Edit this term. Saving changes what new AI runs follow.

tryText.title: Try a text
tryText.meta: No AI call, costs nothing. Reads saved wording only.
tryText.outputHint: Paste what the AI or a person wrote, to see what would be flagged.
tryText.empty: Type or paste a text to see which terms it holds and what the AI would be told.
tryText.told: The AI is told: the glossary uses "{expected}" for "{term}". An inflected form is fine. Nothing is flagged.
tryText.terms: What the AI would be told
tryText.scopeSpace: Everything AI runs in this space use
tryText.off: This glossary is switched off, so AI runs do not use it.

editor.noDefaultWording: No {missing} wording yet. Named by its {language} wording.

scope.space: Saving applies to new AI runs in this space. Runs already started keep what they began with.
scope.team: Saving applies to new AI runs in every space of this team. Runs already started keep what they began with.

inheritedFrom: This glossary belongs to {owner}, so it is read-only here. Manage it there. AI runs here still use it while it is on.
